title: duck-ui docs build with every mermaid diagram drawn: dmc 0.6.2 (mmdc per diagram) vs 0.6.3 (one browser), and velite

host.velite_mermaid: Google Chrome 154.0.8037.99, one headless launch per page (velite-era rehype-mermaid)

methodology.measured_step: content compile only, not `next build`; same scope as phase 8
methodology.timer: wall-clock around the whole CLI process, including Node startup and config load
methodology.dmc_command: node <@gentleduck/md>/bin/duck-md.mjs build --config bench.config.ts, run in apps/duck
methodology.dmc_config: a bench config that imports duck-ui's own duck-md.config.ts and overrides `root` (a frozen copy of the content) plus `output.data` and `content.mermaid.outputDir` (a scratch directory)

states.cold: scratch directory deleted: no per-doc compile cache, no mermaid SVG cache
states.svg: output and every compile cache (per-doc and preMdx) deleted, mermaid.outputDir SVGs kept; a dmc upgrade invalidates only the per-doc cache, so it costs at most this
states.warm: everything kept from the previous run

methodology.velite_command: node node_modules/.bin/velite build --clean, run in apps/duck of a `git archive` export of a91c669b1, installed from its own bun.lock, with @gentleduck/docs built
methodology.load1_at_start: macOS 1-minute load average sampled as each run starts; it lags, so a high value right after a heavy run is mostly that run's tail

old.duck_ui_commit: a91c669b1 (parent of the velite -> dmc migration commit 5a99f61d3)
old.mermaid: 169 <MermaidDiagram> + 4 ```mermaid; velite's output carries lightSvg/darkSvg for all 169

caveats: not a quiet machine: macOS storage indexing and other dev tools were busy throughout; one 0.6.3 cold run took 129.6 s against 86-88 s for the other two
small samples, n = 2 to 5 per variant
velite and dmc draw with different browsers, each the one its own pipeline uses
phase 8 ran on a 32-thread Linux desktop and does not record whether mmdc was installed; without it dmc draws nothing (MmdcUnavailable), so its numbers do not compare with these
